# Set up cmux with Chief

<!-- Generated by `cmux setup list --prompts-md` from `TASKS` in cmux-tui/crates/cmux-tui/src/cli/setup.rs; a test fails when they differ. -->

Paste one of these into Chief, or any agent chat in cmux. Each one runs a `cmux setup` task: the agent does every step it can and tells you only what you must do yourself. Replace the words in capitals (HOST, FOLDER, ...) first.

## Set up this Mac

```text
Set up this Mac for agents: run `cmux setup status`, then run the `fix` it names for the harness, MCP and folder trust checks only. For the Cloud machine, Tailscale and other machines, list what it found and ask me before you change anything. Keep each undo, and tell me only what I must do myself.
```

## Trust a folder so agents start in it without asking

```text
Trust FOLDER so agents start there without asking: run `cmux setup trust FOLDER` and tell me the undo.
```

## Install and sign in an agent harness (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini, ...)

```text
Check that my agent harnesses (Claude Code, Codex, ...) are installed, signed in and current here: run `cmux setup harness`, start any sign-in it names in a terminal beside this chat, and tell me what to click.
```

What only you can do: the harness's own sign-in (OAuth in a browser) and installing its CLI.

## Add an ssh machine as an agent peer, or update or repair one

```text
Add my machine HOST as an agent machine (a Mac on my tailnet such as `studio`, or an ssh host such as `ubuntu@build-1`): run `cmux setup machine HOST`, then run `cmux acp host doctor <name> --json`, where <name> is the `name` that result reports. If ssh refuses, give me the command to try; never ask for my password. Tell me the undo.
```

What only you can do: key-only ssh to the machine: adding a key there or fixing ssh config.

## Update acpmux on peer machines that run an older build

```text
Something is wrong with my agent machine NAME: run `cmux setup status`, and if it lists NAME as outdated or not connected, run the `fix` it names for NAME only. If NAME still fails, run `cmux acp host doctor NAME --fix --json` and tell me what is left.
```

## Check and recover cmux and agent-provider sign-ins

```text
Check and recover my sign-ins: run `cmux accounts list --json`. If cmux is signed out, run `cmux cloud sign-in` and tell me to finish it in the browser; if the command or browser reports offline or Cloud unavailable, stop and tell me to reconnect before retrying. If a provider is missing or expired, open Settings > Accounts and use Sign In or Re-authenticate (or run `cmux accounts reauth --provider PROVIDER`), then run the list again. If I picked the wrong cmux account, use Switch Account in Settings > Accounts and verify the masked account; if a saved key is missing or unreadable, use Add Key there and save or send it without printing the secret. Tell me which providers remain unavailable and never claim an unknown or Keychain-backed sign-in is valid.
```

What only you can do: the cmux sign-in in the browser.

## Create a cmux Cloud machine

```text
Make me a cmux Cloud machine. I know it costs money every hour it runs. Run `cmux setup cloud-machine`, tell me which card to click, and tell me the undo.
```

What only you can do: signing in to cmux, and allowing the new machine on the card cmux shows.

## Serve this machine to the person's other machines over Tailscale

```text
Let my other machines reach this one over Tailscale, for my own Tailscale login only: run `cmux setup tailnet`, tell me the one Tailscale step it names for me (install, start, sign in or approve), and run it again once I have done it. If it asks for my tailnet login, ask me. Tell me the undo.
```

What only you can do: installing Tailscale, signing in to it (`tailscale up`, a browser sign-in), and an admin approving the device when the tailnet requires it.

## Use cmux from an iPhone: pair the cmux iOS app with this Mac

```text
Set up the cmux iPhone app with this Mac: run `cmux settings get mobile.allowIPhoneConnections` and `cmux cloud open-mobile-pairing`. If iPhone connections are off, tell me to turn them on there (only I can). Then tell me to install cmux on my iPhone, sign in there with the same cmux account, and allow the phone on this Mac when it asks.
```

What only you can do: turning on iPhone connections on the Mobile Pairing page, installing the cmux iPhone app (TestFlight invite while it is in beta), signing in there with the same cmux account, and allowing the phone on this Mac when it asks.

## Add another machine with one pasted line (a single-use pairing ticket)

```text
Give me one line to paste on my other machine MACHINE so it can use this one: run `cmux host ticket new --label MACHINE --json` and give me its `install_command` (or its `join_command` when cmux is already installed there). If its `url` starts with ws://, tell me what to forward first. It works once, within 15 minutes; tell me how to revoke it.
```

What only you can do: pasting the line on the other machine.

## Give Claude Code and Codex the cmux MCP server outside cmux (chats cmux starts have it)

```text
Give Claude Code and Codex outside cmux the cmux MCP server: run `cmux setup mcp`. If it names a setting, give me that one line to turn on; do not edit the file. Tell me the undo.
```

What only you can do: turning on "mcp": {"enabled": true} in the cmux settings file.

## Let agents use the Mac (cmux Computer Use)

```text
Let agents use this Mac: run `cmux setup computer-use`, tell me to click Allow on the sheet cmux shows, then open each System Settings pane it names and tell me which switch to turn on.
```

What only you can do: allowing Computer Use on the sheet cmux shows, and the Accessibility and Screen Recording switches in System Settings.

## Bring bookmarks, cookies, history and passwords from another browser

```text
Bring my bookmarks over from BROWSER: run `cmux setup browser-import --browser BROWSER` and tell me the undo. Leave my cookies alone unless I ask.
```

What only you can do: allowing the cookie import on the panel cmux shows and the Keychain prompt; history and password import (Import from Browser...).

## Read and change key bindings

```text
Show me my cmux key bindings: run `cmux keybinding list --json` and list them; to see what one chord does, run `cmux keybinding resolve KEYS --json`.
```

## Let cmux show macOS notifications; choose which show, and mute a workspace

```text
Let cmux show me notifications: run `cmux setup notifications`, then tell me to click Allow on the macOS prompt, or open the System Settings page it names and tell me what to turn on.
```

What only you can do: allowing notifications on the macOS prompt, or turning them on in System Settings > Notifications once denied.

## Invite people to a cmux team, or to a Home conversation

```text
Invite EMAIL to this Home conversation: once I confirm the address, run `cmux home invite --email EMAIL`. Team invites I send myself from the web dashboard (Teams > Members).
```

What only you can do: team invites from the web dashboard (Teams > Members).
